scope: Run-local one-shot VINS telemetry serialized all 798 two-dimensional visual residual observations at the first quality crossing. A read-only observer captured the exact left/right target images for all 11 target stamps. Offline analysis joined every residual to its target image, measured proximity/direction relative to each image’s strongest fitted gradient line, and computed a local structure-tensor anisotropy descriptor. No estimator, health, control, or threshold behavior was changed.

px4_ulog.interpretation: The existing normalized-cost guard aborted the zero-offset action. PX4 entered AUTO_LAND, touched down, briefly entered DESCEND/failsafe after touchdown, and disarmed. EV fusion was present and GNSS aiding flags remained zero. This diagnostic does not qualify navigation success.

full_observation_edge_analysis.method: Each residual observation is joined by target_stamp_ns and camera side to its captured mono image. For each image, the largest absolute vertical intensity gradient at each x within y=270..419 is fit with an ordinary least-squares line over x=10..629. Signed edge distance and residual projections onto the fitted line tangent and normal are computed. An 11x11 Sobel structure tensor at each target coordinate provides a local minimum-to-maximum eigenvalue ratio as a texture anisotropy descriptor.
full_observation_edge_analysis.interpretation: All 38 observations above 1.5 approximate pixel-equivalent norm (and above 3) come from six feature IDs. Every one lies within 0.289 px of the per-image strongest fitted gradient line, has residual tangent magnitude greater than normal magnitude, and has 11x11 Sobel structure-tensor min/max ratio below 0.01. They sum to 891.526 Huber cost (98.502% of visual robust cost). In contrast, the 760 observations at or below 1.5 have median structure-tensor ratio 0.784 and contribute 1.498% of visual Huber cost. This strongly supports anisotropic edge tracks as the proximate source of this run’s visual cost spike; it does not prove a unique causal mechanism or semantic edge label.

interpretation.supported: The full visual residual set, not only the top20, localizes virtually all high-cost blocks to six strongly anisotropic image features whose residuals run along the local edge tangent.
not_established: whether the six features are tracked to the wrong physical points or reflect another geometry/model mismatch
whether rejecting anisotropic features improves navigation accuracy
generalization to other worlds or motion profiles
interpretation.next_step: A run-only, opt-in anisotropy filter at the feature-tracking stage is a testable intervention. Keep the existing normalized-cost and PX4 safety gates; compare feature count, residual distribution, estimator accuracy and action outcome before considering any canonical change.
